title: Karma School Loop: Notebook Edition

selected_categories.reasoning: The game centers on managing a repeated day of school life, balancing social choices, personal well-being, and consequences across a compact daily routine.
Moment-to-moment play is driven by tapping authored choices that branch into different scene outcomes, stat changes, and follow-up nodes.
Players inhabit a teen school persona and define behavior through kind, romantic, rebellious, criminal, or chaotic actions rather than mechanical dexterity.
The structure resembles a condensed life-choice toy where each decision influences karma, relationships, injury state, and the feel of the day.
The title, reset screen, and day-cycle logic explicitly frame the experience as a repeated loop in which each day restarts after eight actions.

uncertainty_notes: There is overlap between Life simulator, Roleplay simulator, and Life choices simulator because the game is a lightweight narrative hybrid rather than a deep sim.
Time loop game is important to the framing and reset structure, but the mechanical core still feels more choice-life-sim than puzzle-like loop optimization.
Interactive novel game was considered, but the interface is more stat-driven and toy-like than text-forward or dialogue-heavy.
